title: marketplace: when the catalog host is unreachable the error panel shows the raw "fetch failed" and reads the 502 as "the catalog returned an error", pointing the admin at the wrong cause
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (23 cards: hotcrm 10, objectui 10, objectstack 3). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (`@objectstack/console` 18.1.0, a runtime whose outbound network is blocked)

Setup → 浏览应用市场: `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages?limit=100` answers 502 (the runtime could not reach the catalog host). The panel reads:

> 应用市场加载失败
> 应用市场目录返回了错误(HTTP 502)。
> fetch failed
> 应用市场目录通过本运行时访问。请检查运行时是否在线、能否访问该目录。
> [重试]

Two things mislead: the catalog did not "return an error", the runtime's fetch to it failed (the third line says so, in the raw Node error string); and "fetch failed" is a developer string on an admin page. [t03-应用市场.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t03-应用市场.png).

`reach:` the public UI, measured once as the dev admin on an intranet-style sandbox; every air-gapped or proxied deployment meets it.

## Expected

The runtime's marketplace proxy tells upstream-unreachable apart from upstream-error (it knows: `fetch failed` vs a response), and the panel says 「运行时无法连接应用市场目录（<host>）。请检查运行时的出网或代理设置。」 with the raw error behind a 「详情」 toggle (T2-U07's rule: one plain sentence, details behind More).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "marketplace page error shows fetch failed when catalog unreachable" → 5 hits: objectstack-ai/objectui#11688 (closed: wrong cause named for a 403 allowlist refusal, the same family), objectstack-ai/objectui#12097, objectstack-ai/objectui#11726, objectstack-ai/objectui#11627, objectstack-ai/objectui#5557 — none covers the unreachable-host case. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §7 S1.
